data.narrative:
Parry Labs is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by John Parkes and Robert Miller that has raised $80M+. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities operating in the same sector and stage. The private peer set includes Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $80M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $152M. Peer-median valuation across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer median reflects valuations including Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $129M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $576M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Parry Labs' relative competitive positioning and technology differentiation within the defense sector peer set. Stage-progression implies the lower bound, while peer comparables anchor the upper range. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and IP defensibility relative to the identified peer universe.
